query:
UPDATE threads
               SET participants = participants - $2::text,
                   lastreplyat = (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(createat), 0) FROM posts WHERE rootid = $1 AND deleteat = 0),
                   replycount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE rootid = $1 AND deleteat = 0)
             WHERE postid = $1
               AND replycount > 0
